vault_pause.help: Holds new cloud operations until you resume, including queued Owner uploads. Running operations finish; recoveries, scans and folder monitoring continue. Nothing is deleted and protection is not stopped.
vault_pause.paused_notice: {name} is paused until you resume it. Queued cloud operations wait; running operations finish and recoveries continue. New Local Copies are catalogued but automatic uploads do not start. Nothing is deleted.
vault_pause.resumed_notice: {name} is resumed. Existing queued cloud operations are eligible again; files are not requeued or duplicated.

activity.stable_in: First waiting files can become stable in about {minutes} min, if unchanged. Scheduling and checks can delay upload start.
activity.waiting_observation: Waiting for a fresh stability observation; no reliable start time yet.

activity.unavailable: Activity could not be refreshed. Any counts shown are from the last successful observation.
activity.cancel_pending: Cancel pending uploads of this Vault
activity.cancel_pending_confirm: Cancel uploads that have not started and stop preparing new uploads for this Vault? Running uploads and ambiguous sends keep their own controls. Local and cloud copies stay untouched. Automatic uploads skip the cancelled files until they change.
move.title: Move the entire Vault now
move.help: Only verified current copies move to a colder class on the saved Storage Plan. Equal or colder files and files with pending work are skipped. Glacier sources require an explicit recovery of their exact version; this action never requests a recovery or warms content.
move.vault_changed: The selected Vault changed. Refresh these settings before moving content.
move.estimate_pricing: Source retrieval {retrieval}. AWS list prices for {region}, published {date} (USD used 1:1 as EUR).
move.exclusions: Estimate, not a bill. Copy/verification requests, additional destination readback retrieval, minimum billable object sizes, archive metadata, temporary restored storage and early-deletion fees are excluded. Multipart verification reads the source. Actual eligibility is rechecked in the background.
move.minimum: The destination bills at least {days} days. Copying resets its age and Storage Plan clock. Removing the old copy before its minimum duration can incur an additional charge, even if a Local Copy exists.
move.acknowledge: I understand the estimated costs, minimum duration and early-deletion charges. Cold copies can require hours to recover.
move.queued: {count} move Jobs queued. Follow progress or cancel pending work in Operations; cancellation retains copies and does not undo a completed move.
move.unavailable: No eligible copies for a colder class. Standard has no move action; otherwise verify copies, finish pending work or explicitly recover cold sources first.
move.skip_cloud_check_unavailable: {count} skipped: the exact cold source could not be checked with the provider.
move.skip_pending_work: {count} skipped: pending work (including delayed cloud deletion).
move.skip_unverified_or_unavailable: {count} skipped: current cloud copy not verified or available.
move.skip_already_equal_or_colder: {count} skipped: already equal or colder, or unsupported transition.
move.skip_explicit_restore_required: {count} skipped: exact cold source version must be explicitly recovered first.

verification.help: Only new uploads use this choice; retries keep their original evidence. The S3 SHA-256 check proves AWS received the right bytes, but it is not an independent reread. Missing proof falls back to downloading the whole file, with data transfer charges; contradictory proof blocks protection.

verification.checksum_api_unsupported: Checksum API unsupported: full exact-version read-back fallback.
verification.legacy_expected_missing: Legacy version without independent S3 evidence: durable plaintext SHA-256 read-back required.
verification.egress: Full read-back downloads all bytes and may incur retrieval and egress charges.
reconciliation.reason.upload_journal_una: The upload receipt log is unavailable. Restore database write availability; the operation resumes automatically without spending transfer retries.
job.upload_journal_waiting: Waiting for the upload receipt journal; transfer retries are unchanged
New upload sends are waiting for the receipt journal. Transfer retries are not consumed. Check database write availability; existing upload intents remain protected against a repeated send.

notification.recovery_approval.body: One recovery request for {count} files needs your approval (estimated cost: {cost}). Open Active operations to approve or cancel it. If unanswered before its deadline, the whole request is cancelled; no cloud recovery starts automatically.
notification.internal_error.title: Problem: internal error
notification.internal_error.body: An internal error occurred in {component}. Protection may be delayed; check the server logs.
notification.file_unreadable.title: Problem: unreadable path
notification.file_unreadable.body: Cannot read {path}. Check the permissions on this file or folder. Until it is readable it is neither protected nor watched in real time, and the Vault stays unconfirmed: no local space is freed and nothing is deleted from the cloud. The other files keep being uploaded. FrostVault looks at this path every minute and scans again as soon as it is readable.
notification.file_name_unsupported.title: Problem: unsupported file name
notification.file_name_unsupported.body: The name of {path} is not valid UTF-8, so it cannot be protected, and nothing under it is catalogued or watched in real time. Rename the file or folder (for example from a computer that shows the real name). Until then the Vault stays unconfirmed: no local space is freed and nothing is deleted from the cloud. The other files keep being uploaded. The problem closes at the first scan that no longer finds the name.
notification.upload_reconciliation.title: Cloud upload reconciliation required
remediation.title: Exact upload remediation
remediation.phase.upload: Nothing reached the cloud; the upload restarted and awaits verification
remediation.help: Keep copies and correct the reported condition before exact reconciliation. Cloud verification does not prove protection of the current Local Copy. No arbitrary removal is authorized; the upload restarts only when S3 proves nothing was written.
reconciliation.title: Cloud cleanup / upload reconciliation
reconciliation.help: A verified keeper remains protected when available. Reconciliation never repeats an upload that may have reached S3 and never removes different unknown content; it sends again only when S3 proves nothing was written, and never while protection is paused. Duplicate checks read exact cloud versions and may incur retrieval/egress charges.
reconciliation.reason.ambiguous_send: The provider outcome is uncertain. Keep copies, stop external S3 writers and retry once the outcome is known. The upload restarts by itself only when S3 positively proves that nothing was written.
reconciliation.reason.list_permission_de: S3 refused to list object versions or incomplete multipart uploads for this file, so reconciliation cannot see what was sent. Keep copies, grant the archive IAM identity s3:ListBucketVersions and s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads, then retry.
reconciliation.reason.read_permission_de: S3 refused to read an object version of this file, so its upload cannot be confirmed. Keep copies, grant the archive IAM identity s3:GetObject and s3:GetObjectVersion, then retry.
reconciliation.reason.abort_permission_d: S3 refused to abort an incomplete multipart upload of this file; its parts are still stored. Grant the archive IAM identity s3:AbortMultipartUpload, then retry (the bucket lifecycle also reaps them after 7 days).
reconciliation.reason.write_permission_d: S3 refused to write this file although the bucket is reachable; nothing was stored. Grant the archive IAM identity s3:PutObject and s3:AbortMultipartUpload, then retry.
reconciliation.reason.ambiguous_receipt: Ambiguous provenance or receipts. Keep all copies; inspect exact versions using authorized S3 tools. Never choose latest by token.
reconciliation.reason.inventory_changed: Cloud inventory changed. Stop external S3 writers and keep copies before retrying reconciliation.
reconciliation.reason.identity_changed: Expected Vault/path/Source Volume or operation ownership changed. Restore the expected volume and resolve conflicting operations first.
reconciliation.reason.proof_unavailable: Make the exact version readable, explicitly recover it if it is in a cold class, check permissions and retry. This action does not automatically recover or delete unproved content.
reconciliation.reason.proof_mismatch: Contradictory independent proof. Keep copies and investigate the exact version; no permissive fallback or deletion.
reconciliation.reason.orphan_different: Unknown content differs from the verified keeper and is retained. Recover/export it with authorized S3 tools or the Recovery Kit and seek assistance. No arbitrary removal action is offered.
reconciliation.reason.cleanup_unavailabl: The verified keeper is retained but cleanup could not finish. Check provider permissions/connectivity and retry exact reconciliation. In-flight/completed deletes cannot be undone.
reconciliation.reason.keeper_missing: The exact verified keeper is unavailable. Restore access before cleanup; keep every other copy.
reconciliation.reason.markers_present: Delete markers are retained: replacement has no consent to remove them. Reconcile explicitly using authorized S3 tools.
reconciliation.reason.retry_budget_exhau: Automatic reconciliation budget exhausted. Correct the cause and retry explicitly; consumed attempts remain in history.
reconciliation.reason.expected_evidence_: Independent expected-content evidence is missing. Keep copies: a remote checksum or the current Local Copy cannot replace it.
reconciliation.reason.target_superseded: The exact version was superseded or purged. It is not revived as keeper; retain and consult history.
reconciliation.reason.target_unavailable: The exact version is unavailable. Restore access without choosing another version or uploading the file again.
reconciliation.reason.vault_suspended: The Vault is paused, needs reconnecting or has stopped protection. No reconciliation is admitted until its state permits it.
reconciliation.reason.source_volume_unav: The expected Source Volume is unavailable or untrustworthy. Restore it before exact reconciliation.
reconciliation.reason.protection_paused: Automatic protection is paused or this path is excluded. Resume protection first: reconciliation will not start an upload while it is paused.
reconciliation.reason.active_operation: Another operation owns this file. Reconciliation waits without creating competing work.
reconciliation.reason.pending_deletion: Deletion is already planned for this file. Reconciliation does not alter that consent or its targets.
reconciliation.reason.cloud_only_conflic: There is a Cloud-only Conflict. Resolve it through the dedicated workflow before reconciliation.
reconciliation.reason.already_resolved: Nothing to reconcile: this upload has already been resolved.
reconciliation.reason.owner_cancelled: The Owner cancelled reconciliation. This target remains excluded from automation.
reconciliation.reason.transient: Temporary failure. The next attempt uses the same exact version and durable budget.
reconciliation.reason.operation_failed: Reconciliation failed and is blocked. Keep copies, correct the cause and retry exact reconciliation.
uploads.admission.pending: Preparing: {processed} of {selected} catalog paths considered; {admitted} operations admitted. Transfers progress separately.
uploads.admission.completed: Queue preparation complete: {admitted} operations admitted from {selected} catalog paths. Transfers may still be running.

uploads.whole_started: Request accepted. Uploads are being prepared in batches; follow progress in upload activity.

general.reconnect_help: Explicitly accept a new Source Volume or different folder for this Vault. Other Vaults are not reconnected. A reason is required.
general.reconnect_active_hint: Only needed when this Vault's data moved to another volume or folder. After a metadata restore, this Vault's own managed folder is the usual choice.
general.reconnect_own_managed_help: The same managed folder this Vault was created in. It is never created again: if it is missing, reconnect is refused.
general.reconnect_path: Destination folder on the Source Volume
general.reconnect_scan_warning: Local work stays suspended until cloud reconciliation and the mandatory full scan succeed. Matching files become Protected, missing files Cloud-only; different bytes are held as conflicts, never uploaded automatically.

recovery_kit.title: Recovery Kit
recovery_kit.help: One installation-wide kit with the metadata master key, bucket, region and manual S3 recovery instructions. Contains no catalog or AWS credentials. Store it outside this server and compare its fingerprint after configuration changes.
recovery_kit.acknowledge: I have stored this fingerprint's kit outside this server
recovery_kit.acknowledged: Custody confirmed for the current kit.
recovery_kit.unconfigured: Configure a valid ARCHIVE_MASTER_KEY, bucket and region to generate the kit.
recovery_kit.error: Recovery Kit request failed. No recovery material was logged.
recovery_kit.changed: The kit changed or custody could not be saved. Download the current kit and check its fingerprint.
recovery_kit.restore_warning: Restored backup dated {date}: {count} files updated from the cloud. Settings changed after the backup must be reapplied manually. Reconnect every Vault before trusting local observations.
folder_settings.retention_help: Off by default. Frees all Protected files in this Vault, without exceptions or upload filters. Cloud copies remain recoverable. To keep some files local, use a separate Vault with this rule off.
folder_settings.retention_example: The period starts at the latest content observation, cloud verification, local modification or recovery. Old imports and recovered files get a full new period. Cold copies may take hours to recover and incur costs.
folder_settings.retention_never: Release rechecks the exact cloud version and local bytes. Changed files, an unavailable Source Volume or unconfirmed cloud protection block release. Manual Free local space remains an explicit confirmed action, even with this rule off.
folder_settings.retention_period_help: Applies to all files, including cold cloud copies. Changing the period recalculates eligibility; disabling stops queued automatic releases.
folder_settings.policy_auto_upload: Enable automatic upload for this Vault
ui.confirm_free_space_description: Removes only the Local Copy of {count} items after the cloud Archive Version is verified. Cloud data is not deleted.
ui.recover_irreversible_note: S3 RestoreObject cannot be cancelled after AWS accepts it.
ui.cloud_purge_intro: Permanently delete the selected Cloud-only files after seven days. Cancel before deletion starts.

ui.cloud_purge_submit: Schedule cloud deletion in seven days
ui.cloud_purge_local_note: Files present on the server cannot be deleted from the cloud. A reappearing local file cancels the request.

general.sources_subtitle: Operator-mounted filesystems under /sources. Nested mounts are unsupported.
general.sources_nested_mount_help: Mount every filesystem directly under /sources/<alias> as a sibling. Nested mounts inside a Source Volume are unsupported so one Vault can never cross volumes.
folder_settings.plan_help: One plan applies to the whole Vault. Changing it never deletes cloud content or moves files immediately.
folder_settings.plan_standard_only_help: Stay in Standard: immediate access without retrieval fees; highest storage cost.
folder_settings.plan_economical_help: Standard-IA at day 30, Glacier Instant Retrieval at day 90: immediate access with lower storage cost, retrieval fees and 30/90-day minimum billing.
folder_settings.plan_archive_tiered_help: Standard-IA at day 30, Glacier Instant Retrieval at day 90, Deep Archive at day 365: progressively cheaper storage; after day 365 recovery takes hours and has retrieval fees and 180-day minimum billing.
folder_settings.plan_deep_archive_early_: Deep Archive at day 0 (next AWS lifecycle evaluation): lowest storage cost, recovery in hours with retrieval fees; replacement or deletion before 180 days still incurs minimum storage charges.
folder_settings.plan_custom_help: Ordered steps are object ages since upload, not delays between steps. IA starts at day 30; leave at least 30 days in IA and 90 in Glacier Instant Retrieval or Glacier Flexible Retrieval before a colder step. Transition and retrieval fees and minimum billing apply.
folder_settings.plan_sync_pending: Plan saved; cloud synchronization is pending and will retry during reconciliation.
folder_settings.plan_invalid: Use increasing nonnegative whole days and colder classes. IA requires day 30 and 30 days residence; Glacier Instant/Flexible Retrieval requires 90 days before a colder step. One Zone-IA cannot transition to Glacier Instant Retrieval.
folder_settings.plan_caveats: AWS applies transitions asynchronously based on object age; existing older objects may transition soon. Objects below 128 KB stay in their class by default. Early replacement can incur minimum-duration charges. There are no expiration or noncurrent-version rules; a warmer plan does not restore already cold content. One Zone-IA uses a single Availability Zone.
stop_protection.title: Stop protecting this Vault
stop_protection.local_retained: All local files remain untouched. Protection and automatic freeing stop.
stop_protection.delete: Delete from cloud after seven days
stop_protection.delete_help: Only Cloud-only files can be deleted. If any cloud-backed file is present on the server, choose Keep. Recent reauthentication is required. Cancellation keeps cloud copies; it does not resume protection.
stop_protection.stopped: Protection stopped. The local folder is released.
stop_protection.pending: Protection stopped. The local folder stays reserved while cloud deletion is pending.
stop_protection.cloud_retained_help: Retained cloud files remain in their original S3 namespace. Recover them with the Recovery Kit instructions and any authorized S3 tool.
stop_protection.cancel_deletion: Cancel deletion and keep cloud copies
stop_protection.keep_remaining: Keep remaining cloud copies and release the folder
stop_protection.failed_help: Deletion partially failed. Completed deletions cannot be undone. Keep the remaining copies to release this Vault's folder safely.
essential.name: Name
essential.protection_help: New and changed files are uploaded and verified automatically, usually within about one hour. Pausing never deletes cloud content.
essential.email_help: Fixed notifications: problems, recovery results and weekly summary. Configure SMTP_TO_ADDRESS and SMTP transport in the deployment environment; APP_PUBLIC_URL enables links back to the file. No event preferences.
essential.estimate_caveat: AWS list-price estimate, not a budget or bill; USD list figures are shown 1:1 as EUR, not a currency conversion. Requests, minimum sizes/durations, temporary restored storage and early-deletion fees may add costs.
essential.not_bill: Storage estimate, not an AWS bill
essential.vault_unavailable: This Vault is unavailable. Choose another one from the menu.
essential.recover_help: Recover the current verified cloud copy to the same Vault.
essential.recovered_retention: Stays on the server for at least a full {days} days after recovery before automatic release.
essential.recovered_keep: Automatic release is off: the recovered file stays on the server.
essential.recover_needs_approval: Needs your approval before it starts
essential.recover_approval_notice: This recovery is above the high-impact limit. Nothing is recovered from the cloud until you approve it in Active operations.
essential.recover_notification: You can close this page. Recovery completion or failure appears in Notifications and optional email.
essential.conflict_help: Different new content is held back to preserve the only cloud copy. Rename the new file outside FrostVault to keep both, or explicitly replace the cloud copy.
essential.problem_help: The file is not protected. Check the source and cloud configuration. If an upload failed, retry after correcting the cause.
essential.excluded_help: Automatic upload skips this file because of a default rule (such as ._* or .DS_Store) or a Vault exclusion. It is not pending and does not count against the Vault's protection. Its current content is not expected to be in the cloud.
essential.stopped_help: Upload stopped by you: it does not start automatically until the file changes.
essential.unsupported_symlink_help: This is a symbolic link. FrostVault never follows links, for safety, so it is not archived. It is not a problem and does not count against the Vault's protection. To protect the content, copy the target file into the Vault.
essential.unsupported_other_help: This is a special file (such as a pipe, socket or device) that cannot be archived. It is not a problem and does not count against the Vault's protection.
essential.replace_warning: The new local content will replace the only recoverable cloud copy after verification. Rename the new file instead if you need both.
essential.deletion_pending: Cloud deletion is pending for seven days. Cancel before execution starts.
general.sources_diagnostic_absent: The expected mount is absent. Restore the same Source Volume at this alias; the catalog remains available.
general.sources_diagnostic_inaccessible: The mount is present but FrostVault cannot read and search it. Restore container-user permissions.
general.sources_diagnostic_replaced: A different Source Volume is mounted at this alias. Local work is blocked; restore the expected mount. Replacement cannot be accepted by retry or rescan.
general.sources_diagnostic_identity_ambi: Linux reports ambiguous mount identity. Remove stacked/duplicate mounts and restore one direct mount.
general.sources_diagnostic_identity_unsu: This mount does not expose sufficient supported stable identity metadata. Local work remains blocked.
general.sources_diagnostic_read_only: The expected Source Volume is read-only. Restore a direct read-write mount.
general.sources_diagnostic_mount_lost: The Source Volume mount was lost. Restore the expected direct mount.
general.sources_diagnostic_scan_required: The expected Source Volume returned. Run a full local scan before local operations resume.
general.sources_diagnostic_unavailable: Local Source Volume access is unavailable.
general.sources_diagnostic_invalid: This entry under /sources is not a Source Volume: it is an ordinary folder, a file or a symbolic link. Mount the filesystem directly as /sources/<alias> or remove the entry. Only this alias is affected.
